description: K₃Na(WO₄)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are two inequivalent K sites. In the first K site, K is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.79-3.24 Å. In the second K site, K is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.64-3.24 Å. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent WO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.52 Å. W is bonded to four O atoms to form WO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 9-43°. There is one shorter (1.79 Å) and three longer (1.81 Å) W-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four K, one Na, and one W atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two K and one W atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four K, one Na, and one W atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three K, one Na, and one W atom.
